questions.prompt: Explain step by step how soap removes an oily stain from a cloth.
questions.modelAnswer: Soap molecules have a hydrophilic ionic head and a hydrophobic hydrocarbon tail. In water, the tails dissolve into the oily stain while the heads stay in the water. The molecules surround tiny droplets of oil, forming micelles with the oil trapped inside. Scrubbing and rinsing carry the micelles, and the oil, away in the water.
rubric: Tails in oil, heads in water: micelles
